tools.name: validate_app_links
tools.description: Inspect and validate Apple App Site Association (apple-app-site-association) and Android Digital Asset Links (assetlinks.json) files, HTTPS hosting rules, and test URL path routing, and compare the origin AASA with the copy on Apple's CDN.

tools.name: audit_website_seo
tools.description: Run a deterministic technical SEO audit for a public website URL. Checks canonicals, title tags, headings, robots.txt, sitemaps, redirects, crawl traps, and indexability.

tools.name: transpile_to_caddyfile
tools.description: Transpile Nginx (nginx.conf, server blocks) or Apache (.htaccess, VirtualHost) web server configuration to clean, idiomatic Caddyfile with migration advisories.

tools.name: calculate_cidr_overlap
tools.description: Analyze IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnets for range collisions, full containment, 2D bit-tree matrix partition, and available free subnet allocation.

tools.name: diagnose_cors_policy
tools.description: Analyze CORS HTTP request and response headers for wildcard/credential security violations, missing Vary: Origin, preflight OPTIONS handling, and header exposure.

tools.name: trace_dns_delegation
tools.description: Query live DNS records and inspect the authoritative nameservers returned for a domain.

tools.name: inspect_domain_security
tools.description: Inspect domain email security and deliverability standards: DMARC (BIMI compliance), BIMI DNS & SVG reachability, MTA-STS (RFC 8461), SMTP TLS-RPT (RFC 8460), SPF and MX records.

tools.name: generate_favicon_suite
tools.description: Generate modern multi-platform favicon bundle (adaptive dark-mode SVG, multi-resolution ICO, Apple Touch Icon, Android PWA icons, webmanifest) and minimal HTML tags from SVG or image input.

tools.name: analyze_geo_readiness
tools.description: Analyze Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) signals and AI crawler readiness for a web page (schema, citations, provenance, answer structure, llms.txt, AI bot robots rules).

tools.name: inspect_apple_pkpass
tools.description: Inspect and validate Apple Wallet .pkpass JSON structure (pass.json) or package manifests: checks required keys, pass styles, dates, ISO 8601 timezones, transit types, barcodes, and color contrast.

tools.name: generate_apple_pkpass_spec
tools.description: Generate a production-ready, fully compliant Apple Wallet pass.json specification based on pass type, metadata, colors, barcode, and field values.

tools.name: repair_apple_pkpass_spec
tools.description: Automatically repair and sanitize broken Apple Wallet pass.json manifests: fixes missing formatVersion, prefixes passTypeIdentifier, ensures 10-character team ID, normalizes dates to ISO 8601 with timezones, and auto-corrects low contrast.

tools.name: transpile_regex_engine
tools.description: Transpile and analyze regular expressions across engines (PCRE, Go RE2, JavaScript, Python re, Rust regex) with compatibility checks and ReDoS safety analysis.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_website_seo · Private data: validate_app_links, diagnose_cors_policy, trace_dns_delegation, inspect_domain_security, inspect_apple_pkpass, generate_apple_pkpass_spec, repair_apple_pkpass_spec · Public sink: diagnose_cors_policy, inspect_domain_security · Destructive: audit_website_seo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_website_seo · Private data: validate_app_links, diagnose_cors_policy, trace_dns_delegation, inspect_domain_security, inspect_apple_pkpass, generate_apple_pkpass_spec, repair_apple_pkpass_spec · Public sink: diagnose_cors_policy, inspect_domain_security · Destructive: audit_website_seo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
